inputs.title: Decycler Period
inputs.tooltip: Sets the cutoff period of the two-pole Ehlers Decycler applied independently to high, low, and close. Higher values remove longer cyclical fluctuations.

inputs.title: ATR Length
inputs.tooltip: Sets the ATR lookback used to normalize channel padding and directional movement.

inputs.title: Channel Padding (ATR)
inputs.tooltip: Sets the additional ATR-based distance outside the Decycler high-low channel. Higher values tolerate deeper pullbacks and reduce trend switching.

inputs.title: Decycler Slope Length
inputs.tooltip: Sets the number of candles used to measure directional movement of the Decycler close.
Sets the minimum ATR-normalized Decycler slope required for an ordinary channel breakout to reverse the active trend.
inputs.title: Slope Confirmation

inputs.tooltip: Controls the expansion of the protective channel boundary when the Decycler moves in the direction of the established trend.
inputs.title: Trend Breathing Room
Strong Breakout Override (ATR)
inputs.tooltip: Sets the additional ATR distance beyond a channel boundary that allows a decisive price breakout to reverse the trend without slope confirmation.
Shows or hides the Decycler calculated from closing prices. This setting does not affect calculations or signals.
inputs.title: Show Decycler Centerline
Show Decycler Channel
inputs.tooltip: Shows or hides the upper and lower Decycler channel boundaries.

inputs.title: Show Active Reversal Boundary
inputs.tooltip: Shows or hides the active trend reversal boundary, including ATR padding and directional breathing room.

inputs.title: Show Channel Fill
inputs.tooltip: Shows or hides the shaded area between the upper and lower Decycler channel boundaries.
Controls the transparency of the upper and lower Decycler channel lines. Zero is fully opaque and 100 is invisible.
inputs.title: Channel Transparency
Channel Fill Transparency
inputs.tooltip: Controls the transparency of the shaded region between the Decycler channel boundaries. Higher values produce a lighter background.

inputs.title: Show Signals
inputs.tooltip: Shows or hides LONG and SHORT triangles on the main price chart when the confirmed trend regime changes.

inputs.title: Color Bars
inputs.tooltip: Shows or hides candle coloring according to the active bullish or bearish trend regime.

inputs.title: Bullish Color
inputs.tooltip: Bullish Color represents bullish conditions and LONG signals, while Bearish Color represents bearish conditions and SHORT signals.
Bullish Color represents bullish conditions and LONG signals, while Bearish Color represents bearish conditions and SHORT signals.
